hook: HYDRAA chief appears in HC in a *contempt* case over Shamshabad land
hook_b: HYDRAA chief appears in HC in a *contempt* case over Shamshabad land
tldr: Commissioner A V Ranganath and Tahsildar Amaralingam appeared before Justice C V Bhaskar Reddy over alleged non-compliance with an Oct 23, 2024 order; the case was adjourned by two weeks.

beats.what: The petitioner alleges officials took possession of land in Survey No. 626/2AA, demolished a structure and put up fencing with a government nameplate.
beats.why: The 2024 order had asked authorities to examine his documents and pass a reasoned order on removing the land from the prohibitory list.
beats.care: The case tests how HYDRAA's land actions square with earlier court directions on disputed plots.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 16): the court dispensed with the officials' personal appearance after recording their presence.

cards.q: Should agencies have to issue notice before fencing disputed land?
opts: Not if it's clearly govt land

qs: What does Section 22-A of the Registration Act let authorities do?
How are disputed plots removed from the prohibitory list?

facts.t: The 2024 order let the petitioner seek deletion of land from the prohibitory list under *Section 22-A(4)*.

viz.verdict: Court yet to rule; officials say nothing in report

steps.e: HC orders authorities to review documents
Land fenced as govt property, petitioner says

watch: The next hearing after two weeks, once the petitioner's counsel files a reply.
